messages:
jamie: Morning — bringing up morpheus13b int4 canary. seeing OOMs on prefetch-heavy traces after ~2k tokens, memory spike then slab churn. repro attached.

rafi: ugh. can you paste the exact runner args and logs? also which kernel (v1/v2) are we on for this build?

jamie: running runtime v2.3.1, kernel=optimized-attn. args:
```
--quant int4 --prefetch true --batch-size 16 --max_new_tokens 2048 --kv-reserve 0.12
```
log snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T09:12:11Z] alloc slab stripe 0 -> 128MB
[2026-03-22T09:12:12Z] kv_prefetch miss spike (80%)
[2026-03-22T09:12:12Z] GPU OOM while allocating 64MB, free memory 32MB
[2026-03-22T09:12:12Z] falling back to eviction, compaction attempt failed
```

sasha: interesting — looks like a prefetched KV wave + large max_new_tokens combo. we've seen slab stripe growth when many long requests overlap. can we repro with a controlled script that issues 4 concurrent calls of 1500 tokens? also what host GPU type?

jamie: repro script: https://internal/ci/repro/morpheus13b-int4-prefetch.sh (short curl loop). GPUs: A10G nodes. yes can repro locally with that script.

matt: quick suggestions:
- drop max_new_tokens default to 1024 for canary (temporary)
- reduce default batch-size to 8 for int4 morpheus until compaction improvements land
- increase kv-reserve to 0.2 to avoid aggressive eviction under prefetch
- enable async-compact (dev flag) to test

rafi: agree. defaults change first. also add a soft-slo: if allocation fails, short-circuit to v1 kernel path (less prefetch) for that request.

jamie: tried patch. changes applied locally:
```
max_new_tokens: 1024
batch_size: 8
kv_reserve: 0.20
runtime.flags: enable_async_compact=true
```
repro run: 0 OOMs over 1k runs, latency up ~8% avg but stable.

sasha: nice. do we have a perf/regression test? add a small eval to CI that runs 20 long-turn traces and asserts no OOM and <15% latency regression. ci-bot, can we gate canary with that?

ci-bot: added job morpheus-int4-longtrace-smoke to PR checks. threshold: 0 OOMs, p95 latency <= baseline*1.15

matt: next steps:
- ship defaults change as emergency revert for canary group only (route <= 5% traffic)
- queue kernel compaction PR in eng-runtime
- monitor KV miss rate + slab churn in console (new dashboard tiles)

jamie: flagged rollout PR: https://internal/pr/4287 — traffic rule pinned to canary. will monitor. rolling in 5m.

rafi: if we still see spill patterns, fallback plan B: disable prefetch for morpheus13b int4 permanently until compaction patch merges.

sasha: logging checklist for post-rollout: attach heapmaps, slab stripe histograms, KV miss heatmap, and per-request token-length histogram.

jamie: rollout started. initial telemetry: KV miss down 30%, compaction ops increased, slab stripe growth plateaued. no OOMs seen so far. p95 latency +9%.

matt: good. hold on canary for 2h then expand to 20% if stable. cheers :thumbsup:

jamie: closing thread after monitoring window. will open follow-up if regression or regression-eval fails. thanks everyone. :rocket:
